Gaps between adjacent replication tracks

Source: R/tracks.R
calc_rep_track_gaps.Rd

For each cell, sort the tracks and compute the distance between consecutive tracks on the same chromosome (start[i + 1] - end[i] - 1).

Usage

calc_rep_track_gaps(rep_tracks)

Arguments

rep_tracks

Named GRangesList (one element per cell), e.g. from define_replication_tracks(), with metadata columns cell_id and rep_percent.

Value

A data.frame with columns cell_id, rep_percent, chr and gap_bp, one row per adjacent pair.
